questions.topic: Magnitude of a vector in space
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vector v=<3,4,0>. Find its magnitude.
questions.explanation: Magnitude = sqrt(3^2+4^2+0^2)=5. Planar 3-4-5 triangle.
questions.hint: Use sqrt of sum of squares.

questions.learningObjective: Find unit vector in given direction
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, find unit vector in direction of v=<6,0,8>.
questions.explanation: Magnitude 10, unit vector = <0.6,0,0.8>. Value 1 encodes unit length.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, which vector is the standard unit vector along z-axis?
questions.explanation: Standard unit vector along z-axis is k=<0,0,1>.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vector v=<3,4,0>, magnitude 5. Direction cosine with x-axis?
questions.explanation: cos alpha = 3/5 = 0.6. Direction cosine is component over magnitude.

questions.learningObjective: Determine sign of dot product from angle
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, two vectors have angle 120 degrees. Sign of dot product?
questions.explanation: Dot product = |a||b|cos theta. cos 120 = -1/2 < 0, so negative.

questions.learningObjective: Compute dot product of two vectors
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,2,3>, b=<4,5,6>. Dot product?

questions.learningObjective: Use dot product zero for orthogonality
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vectors orthogonal iff their dot product is?
questions.explanation: Orthogonal vectors have dot product zero, since cos 90 = 0.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,0,0>, b=<0,1,0>. Angle between them?
questions.explanation: Dot product 0, so angle 90 degrees.

questions.learningObjective: Compute work as dot product of force and displacement
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, force F=<2,3,1>, displacement d=<4,0,2>. Work?

questions.topic: Cauchy-Schwarz bound on a dot product
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, Cauchy-Schwarz says |a·b| <= ?
questions.explanation: Cauchy-Schwarz: |a·b| <= |a||b|. Equality when parallel.

questions.learningObjective: Compute scalar projection of a onto b
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<3,0,0>, b=<1,0,0>. Scalar projection of a onto b?
questions.hint: Dot divided by magnitude of b.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, projection of a=<2,0,0> onto b=<1,0,0>. Result vector?
In an analyst's dashboard note, perpendicular remainder = a - proj_b a. It is orthogonal to?
questions.explanation: By construction, a - proj_b a is perpendicular to b.

questions.topic: Cross product by the determinant rule
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,0,0>, b=<0,1,0>. Cross product magnitude?
questions.explanation: a×b = <0,0,1>, magnitude 1.

questions.topic: Cyclic order of unit vector products
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, i × j equals?
questions.explanation: Cyclic order: i×j=k, j×k=i, k×i=j.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, direction of a×b is determined by?
questions.explanation: Cross product direction follows right-hand rule: fingers along a, curl to b, thumb gives direction.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,0,0>, b=<0,2,0>. |a×b|?
questions.explanation: a×b=<0,0,2>, magnitude 2. Also |a||b|sin90=2.

questions.learningObjective: Compute area of parallelogram spanned by two vectors
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vectors a=<1,0,0>, b=<0,1,0>. Area of parallelogram?
questions.explanation: Area = |a×b| = 1.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, antisymmetry of cross product means?
questions.explanation: Cross product is antisymmetric: a×b = - (b×a).

questions.learningObjective: Know cross product of parallel vectors is zero
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, cross product of parallel vectors is?
questions.explanation: Parallel vectors have sin theta=0, so cross product zero.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,0,0>, b=<0,1,0>, c=<0,0,1>. a·(b×c)?
questions.hint: Compute b×c then dot with a.

questions.learningObjective: Interpret scalar triple product as volume
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, |a·(b×c)| represents volume of?
questions.explanation: Absolute scalar triple product equals volume of parallelepiped determined by a,b,c.

questions.learningObjective: Use triple product zero for coplanarity
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, three vectors coplanar iff scalar triple product is?
questions.explanation: Coplanar vectors span zero volume, so triple product zero.

questions.topic: Plane from a point and a normal
questions.learningObjective: Write plane equation from point and normal
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, point (1,0,0), normal n=<1,0,0>. Plane equation? value a in x+a?
In an analyst's dashboard note, plane with x-intercept 2, y-intercept 3, z-intercept 6. Intercept form x/2+y/3+z/6=1. Sum of reciprocals?
questions.explanation: Intercept form x/a+y/b+z/c=1. At point (a,0,0) etc. Sum condition holds.

questions.learningObjective: Recognize parallel planes have proportional normals
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, two planes parallel iff their normal vectors are?
questions.explanation: Parallel planes have normals that are scalar multiples, i.e., parallel.

questions.topic: Distance from a point to a plane
questions.learningObjective: Compute distance from point to plane
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, distance from (0,0,0) to plane x=5?
questions.explanation: Distance = |0-5|/1 = 5.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, planes x=2 and x=7. Distance between them?
questions.explanation: Parallel planes x=2 and x=7 distance = |7-2|=5.

questions.topic: Line as the intersection of two planes
questions.learningObjective: Recognize line as intersection of two planes
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a line in 3D can be represented as?
questions.explanation: A line in 3D is intersection of two non-parallel planes.
questions.hint: Two planes intersect in a line.

questions.topic: Unit tangent vector to a space curve
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, r(t)=<t,0,0>. Unit tangent T(t)?
questions.explanation: r'= <1,0,0>, |r'|=1, T=<1,0,0>. Value 1 encodes unit length.

questions.topic: Magnitude of a vector in space
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vector v=<-3,4,-12>. Magnitude?

questions.learningObjective: Find unit vector for negative direction
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, unit vector opposite to v is?
questions.explanation: Opposite unit vector = -v/|v|.

questions.learningObjective: Express vector in terms of i,j,k
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, vector <2,-1,3> equals?

questions.learningObjective: Verify sum of squares of direction cosines equals 1
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, for any vector, cos^2 alpha + cos^2 beta + cos^2 gamma = ?
questions.explanation: Direction cosines satisfy cos^2 alpha + cos^2 beta + cos^2 gamma = 1.
questions.hint: Unit vector components squared sum to 1.

questions.learningObjective: Relate dot product sign to angle type
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, dot product positive iff angle between vectors is?
questions.explanation: Dot product = |a||b|cos theta; positive iff cos theta>0 iff acute angle.

questions.learningObjective: Compute dot product with negative components
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<-1,2,-3>, b=<4,-5,6>. Dot product?
In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,2,k>, b=<2,-1,0>. Orthogonal when? k value?
questions.explanation: Dot = 1*2+2*(-1)+k*0 = 2-2+0 = 0 for any k? Wait independent of k. Hmm. Let's use b=<2,-1,1>: dot=2-2+k=k, orthogonal when k=0. Set b=<2,-1,1>. Value 0.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, if dot product is 0, angle between vectors is?
questions.explanation: Dot product zero implies cos theta=0, so theta=90 degrees (for nonzero vectors).

questions.learningObjective: Recognize zero work when force perpendicular to displacement
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, work is zero when force is?
questions.explanation: Work = F·d = |F||d|cos theta; zero when theta=90 (perpendicular).

questions.topic: Cauchy-Schwarz bound on a dot product
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, equality in Cauchy-Schwarz occurs when vectors are?
questions.explanation: Equality |a·b|=|a||b| iff a and b are parallel (one is scalar multiple of other).

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<-2,0,0>, b=<1,0,0>. Scalar projection of a onto b?
questions.explanation: comp_b a = (a·b)/|b| = -2/1 = -2. Signed projection can be negative.

questions.learningObjective: Compute vector projection onto arbitrary vector
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, projection of a=<1,1,0> onto b=<1,0,0>. Magnitude?
In an analyst's dashboard note, student says remainder a-proj_b a is parallel to b. Find error.

options.text: Remainder is perpendicular to b, not parallel

questions.explanation: By construction, a - proj_b a is perpendicular to b, not parallel.

questions.topic: Cross product by the determinant rule
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<1,2,3>, b=<4,5,6>. z-component of a×b?

questions.topic: Cyclic order of unit vector products
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, j × k equals?
questions.explanation: Cyclic: j×k=i.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, if a points east and b points north, a×b points?
questions.explanation: East × North = Up by right-hand rule.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cross product magnitude for non-perpendicular
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, |a|=3, |b|=4, angle 30. |a×b|?

questions.learningObjective: Compute triangle area from cross product
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, parallelogram area 10. Triangle area?
questions.explanation: Triangle area = half parallelogram area = 5.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, (a×b)+(b×a) equals?
questions.explanation: b×a = -a×b, so sum zero.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, cross product zero implies vectors are?
questions.explanation: Cross product zero iff vectors parallel or at least one zero.

questions.learningObjective: Compute scalar triple product with given vectors
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a=<2,0,0>, b=<0,3,0>, c=<0,0,4>. a·(b×c)?
In an analyst's dashboard note, triple product value 6. Volume of parallelepiped?
questions.explanation: Volume = |triple product| = 6.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, if triple product nonzero, vectors are?
questions.explanation: Nonzero triple product means nonzero volume, so vectors not coplanar.

questions.topic: Plane from a point and a normal
questions.learningObjective: Compute distance from origin to plane
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, plane 2x+0y+0z=10. Distance from origin?
questions.explanation: Distance = |10|/sqrt(4)=10/2=5.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, intercepts (1,0,0),(0,2,0),(0,0,3). Plane: x/1+y/2+z/3=1. At (1,2,3) LHS?
In an analyst's dashboard note, planes 3x=6 and 3x=15. Distance?
questions.explanation: Rewrite 3x-6=0 and 3x-15=0. Distance = |(-6)-(-15)|/3? Actually |c2-c1|/|n| = |-15+6|/3? Let's compute: planes 3x=6 (x=2) and 3x=15 (x=5). Distance = 3.

questions.topic: Distance from a point to a plane
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, distance from (1,2,3) to plane x+y+z=0?
In an analyst's dashboard note, distance between ax+by+cz=d1 and ax+by+cz=d2 is?
questions.explanation: Distance = |d1-d2|/|n| where n=<a,b,c>.

questions.topic: Line as the intersection of two planes
questions.learningObjective: Find direction vector of line as cross product of normals
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, direction vector of intersection line of two planes is?
questions.explanation: Line direction is perpendicular to both normals, so n1×n2.

questions.topic: Unit tangent vector to a space curve
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, r(t)=<cos t, sin t, 0>. At t=0, |r'(0)|?
questions.explanation: r'= <-sin t, cos t, 0>, at 0 = <0,1,0>, magnitude 1.
